# Modular Web Template

> High-performance, architecturally sound web application template built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Vanilla CSS design tokens.

## Architecture
- Framework: React 19 + TypeScript
- Bundler: Vite
- Structure: Gradle-inspired Lightweight Modular Monolith (@core/*, @features/*, @app/*)
- Styling: Zero-overhead Vanilla CSS Design Tokens
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages + Serverless Functions

## Pages
- Home: /
- About: /about
- Contact: /contact
